questions.q: What did Willink do after the friendly-fire death in Ramadi?
a: Took full accountability as the ranking officer
Blamed the other unit involved
Requested a transfer to another unit
Waited for an official inquiry to finish
questions.why: Lesson 1 says his accountability ended up saving his job.

questions.q: What does prioritize and execute mean under pressure?
a: Pick the top priority and handle one thing at a time
Act on every problem simultaneously
Delegate all decisions to the team
Pause until the situation calms down
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes slowing down and taking priorities in order.

questions.q: What is the SEAL mantra for staying calm?
a: Relax, look around, make a call
Stop, drop and roll
Plan, brief, execute
Breathe, focus, repeat
questions.why: Lesson 2 quotes the mantra behind prioritize and execute.

questions.q: How had Babin prepared for the hostage rescue?
a: He had already planned for risks before they were confirmed
He cancelled until backup could arrive
He waited for better intelligence reports
He sent a smaller team in first
questions.why: Lesson 3 says his planning covered the dangers in advance.

questions.q: Why does a leader's accountability spread to the team?
a: Members copy the leader's attitude toward mistakes
It protects the leader from criticism
It speeds up promotion decisions
It reduces the need for training
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the leader's attitude passes down to the team.
